# TPC-Havoc Q12_v8

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT l_shipmode, SUM(CASE WHEN o_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' OR o_orderpriority = '2-HIGH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_line_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o_orderpriority <> '1-URGENT' AND o_orderpriority <> '2-HIGH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_line_count FROM orders, lineitem WHERE o_orderkey = l_orderkey AND l_commitdate < l_receiptdate AND l_shipdate < l_commitdate AND l_receiptdate >= CAST('1994-01-01' AS DATE) AND l_receiptdate < CAST('1994-01-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '1 YEAR' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 WHERE l_shipmode IN ('MAIL', 'SHIP')) GROUP BY l_shipmode ORDER BY l_shipmode
```
